title.name: Mythic Masters
title.subtitle:
A magical book is left to you by aliens fleeing Earth. They leave you with a mission:
Collect Earth's Cryptids or face humanity being WIPED OUT!
title.tagline:
Venture an open world based on reality!
Find each region's cryptids in their natural world habitat equivalent!
Unlock new regions; Find a region's cryptids & beat regional cryptid leaders.
Train up your cryptid army. Challenge stronger & rarer cryptids to Arcade-style Battles.
Determine the best Cryptid Collector!
title.startOver: Burn the book and start over? Click again
imprint: Bound in Cedar Bark of Leeds Point
title.plateCaption: The Book, keeper of cryptid knowledge and energy. Use it to Summon forth your Found, Tamed, Leveled Cryptid army.

starters.heading: The Bog Witch
starters.witch: "You came down in the light, you and the loud one. Nobody believes you. I'm not sure I do. And now you've got their book under your arm, have you? Keep it shut in my yard. Five came to my door this year, out of the pines and the north woods, the desert and the high Alps, and they eat me out of house and home. Take three, and go."
starters.after: She will not touch the Book. It came down with you, it is warm, and it is yours. Her camp is at Leeds Point, if you ever clear anything worth telling her about.
starters.hodag: A hodag pup from the north woods. Hot-blooded, stone-backed, slow to turn and slower to fall.
starters.squonk: A squonk. It weeps, it hides, and its tears are a tide that puts out any fire.
starters.agropelter: An agropelter out of a hollow tree. It throws branches, and it holds a grudge.
starters.jackalope: A jackalope. Six kilos of antler and nerve. Faster than anything in these pines.
starters.tatzelwurm: A tatzelwurm down from the Alps, cat-faced and four-legged. Its bite is poison and its breath is frost.

versus.name: Mythic Masters
versus.librarianTag: Size and weight are real. The small one can win.
versus.bookTag: The Book of Things That Probably Exist. It is not responsible for what it summons.
